title: Ashby integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Ashby
Ashby is an all-in-one recruiting platform that brings applicant tracking, scheduling, sourcing and analytics into a single system. It is built for teams that want structured hiring processes backed by data.
Why Integrate Ashby with Xobin?
Integrating Ashby with Xobin streamlines your hiring process by sending skills assessments to candidates directly within your workflow. It makes tracking candidate performance easy, automates assessment assignment in your pipeline and provides detailed reports. The result is less manual effort and a smoother, data-driven hiring experience.
How to Integrate Ashby with Xobin
Generate the Xobin API key
Log in to your Xobin dashboard.
Open the
Settings
menu and select the
Integrations
tab at the top right.
Choose
Ashby
from the list of available integrations.
Click
Generate API Key
and copy the key.
Enable the Xobin integration in Ashby
Log in to Ashby and select
Admin
in the top menu, then
Search for
Xobin
and click
Enable Xobin
Paste the Xobin API key into the field and click
Update
Create an API key in Ashby
In the left sidebar click
API Keys
New
in the top right and name the key, for example "Xobin Assessments".
For the integration partner select
, then click
Create API Key
Copy the new key and make sure it is linked in the Xobin integration settings as well.
Finalise the integration in Xobin
Return to your Xobin dashboard and click
Edit
under the Ashby integration section.
Paste the Ashby API key and click
Save
. The integration is now complete.
Assign a Xobin assessment to a candidate
In Ashby click
Candidates
in the top menu and open the candidate.
Select
New Activity
, choose
Assessments
and select
Search for the assessment, select it and click
Add Activity
Start Assessment
to send the invite.
Once the test is complete, view qualification status and completion time in Ashby, or click
View in Xobin
for the full report.
Automate assessment assignment in the pipeline
Go to
Jobs > Dashboard
and choose the job.
In the
Interview Plan
section add a new pipeline stage named
Xobin Assessments
Rearrange stages as needed.
Add the assessment to the stage with
Add Activity > Xobin
and search for the test.
Associate a candidate with the job and move them to the Xobin Assessments stage; the assessment is assigned automatically.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for recruitment teams, HR professionals and hiring managers who want to streamline candidate evaluation. It suits organisations that want to automate skills assessments, track performance effortlessly and build assessments into the hiring pipeline, whether for individual roles or bulk recruitment.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Assessments as an Ashby activity
Add a Xobin test to any candidate with New Activity > Assessments > Xobin and send it with Start Assessment.
Pipeline stage automation
Create a Xobin Assessments stage in the interview plan so tests are assigned automatically when candidates reach it.
Two-way key exchange
Xobin's key enables the app in Ashby and an Ashby API key scoped to Xobin completes the connection both ways.
Results inside Ashby
Qualification status and completion time show on the candidate, with View in Xobin for the full detailed report.
Structured, data-backed hiring
Ashby's analytics and Xobin's skill scores sit together, so every stage decision is backed by evidence.
No manual follow-ups
Invites, status changes and result updates run from the pipeline, so recruiters stop chasing candidates over email.
Answers
Frequently asked questions
The Xobin key enables the Xobin app inside Ashby, and an Ashby API key scoped to Xobin lets Xobin write results back. Both are required.
